entries.41a55c17931292b0: This business manufactures and sells separators for aluminum electrolytic capacitors and functional materials such as separators for batteries. As the group has a single segment, the Separator Business, segment information is omitted. The group consists of the company and two consolidated subsidiaries, and the consolidated subsidiaries NKK Solutions Co., Ltd. (Nankoku City, Kōchi Prefecture) and NIPPON KODOSHI KOGYO (MALAYSIA) SDN.BHD. (Malaysia) perform cutting and processing of the company's products. The reporting company has its head office plant (Kōchi City), Aki Plant (Aki City) and Yonago Plant (Yonago City), and the consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 462.
